## Step 8: Expression markers B cell clusters

**GOAL**: Extract list of cluster specific expression markers

**Parameters/thresholds**:

-   `features` = all genes needs to be tested (default)
-   `logfc.threshold` = limit testing to genes which show on average at least X-fold difference (log-scale) between the two groups of cells. Increasing speeds up the function, but can miss weaker signals (default = 0.25)
-   `test.use` = statistical test to use
-   `min.pct` = only test genes that are detected in a minimum fraction of `min.pct` of the cells in either of the two populations (default = 0.1)
-   `min.diff.pct` = only test genes that show a minimum difference in the fraction of detection between two groups (default = -Inf)
-   `only.pos` = only return positive markers (default = FALSE)
-   `return.thresh` = only return makers that have a p-value \< `return.thresh`, or a power \> `return.thresh` if test is ROC

**Outputs**:

-   FindAllMarkers function identifies gene markers for each cluster relative to all other clusters.
-   The expression for a given gene among cells in a given cluster is compared against the expression of that gene among cells in all other clusters.
-   `pct.1` = percentage of *cells in the cluster* where the gene is detected
-   `pct.2` = percentage of cells on average in all the *other clusters* where the gene is detected.
-   A gene to be considered as an *ideal* cluster marker is expected to be expressed *exclusively* in that cluster and silenced in all others and thus `pct.1` will be more towards 1 and `pct.2` towards 0.

```{r DE_GenesProteinsList}
# For the B cell clusters
Idents(IntData_BCells)<-"BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"
# Find differentially expressed genes
DiffMarkers<-FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
# Factorize the clusters
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffMarkers$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score (Noah)
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Save the list
write.csv2(file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                            paste(params$prefix_output, "DEMarkerGenes_BCellClusters.csv", sep = "_")),
           x = DiffMarkers)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffMarkers,
       mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                    y = gene,
                    fill = Score))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#97C7FF", 
                      high = "#002E84")+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank())+
  ylab("Genes")+
  xlab("B cell clusters")+
  labs(fill = "DE score")

# Focus on ADT data
DiffProteins<-FindAllMarkers(IntData_BCells, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.25, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = FALSE, assay="ADT",
                            group.by = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")

# Factorize the clusters
DiffProteins<-DiffProteins%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffProteins$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score (Noah)
DiffProteins<-DiffProteins%>%
  mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)%>%
  arrange(cluster, -Score)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffProteins,
       mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                    y = gene,
                    fill = Score))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#97C7FF", 
                      high = "#002E84")+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank())+
  ylab("Proteins")+
  xlab("B cell clusters")+
  labs(fill = "DE score")

# Save the list
write.csv2(file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers", 
                            paste(params$prefix_output, "DEMarkerProteins_BCellClusters.csv", sep = "_")),
           x = DiffProteins)
```

```{r DE_GenesProteins_MoreInDepth}
# Store the clusters
# Only use the clusters that consist of more than 3 cells
# Clusters_BCells<-(CalClusCount(object = IntData_BCells,
#                                clusters = "BCells_cca_rpca_clusters.wnn",
#                                feature = "BCellCluster", barplot = F)[[1]]%>%
#                     # Filter based on the cell counts per cluster
#                     filter(Counts>3))[,1]
# RNA
# Initialization of a list containing the different clusters
DiffMarkers_List <- list()
# Performing differential gene/protein expression per cluster
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  message(paste0("Working on cluster ", i))
  ident1 <- i # Extract 1 cluster
  ident2 <- Clusters_BCells[Clusters_BCells != i] # vs all
  table <- FindMarkers(IntData_BCells, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2, 
                       min.diff.pct = 0.3, logfc.threshold = 0.3, assay = "RNA")
  if ( dim(table)[1] != 0 ){ # only when there is output
    # Store the genes in a separate row
    table <- rownames_to_column(table, var = "gene")
    # Specify the cluster
    table$cluster <- rep(i, nrow(table))
    # Calculate a DE score
    table$score <- table$pct.1 / (table$pct.2 + 0.01) * table$avg_log2FC
    # Rearranging the order of the genes based on the DE score
    table <- table%>%arrange(-score)
    # Store in list
    DiffMarkers_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]] <- table
  }
}

# Save the list
saveRDS(object = DiffMarkers_List,
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                         paste(params$prefix_output, "DEMarkerGenes_BCellClusters_Expanded.rds", 
                               sep = "_")))

# ADT
# Initialization of a list containing the different clusters
DiffProteins_List <- list()
# Performing differential gene/protein expression per cluster
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  message(paste0("Working on cluster ", i))
  ident1 <- i # Extract 1 cluster
  ident2 <- Clusters_BCells[Clusters_BCells != i] # vs all
  table <- FindMarkers(IntData_BCells, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2, 
                       min.diff.pct = 0.3, logfc.threshold = 0.3, assay = "ADT")
  if ( dim(table)[1] != 0 ){ # only when there is output
    # Store the genes in a separate row
    table <- rownames_to_column(table, var = "gene")
    # Specify the cluster
    table$cluster <- rep(i, nrow(table))
    # Calculate a DE score
    table$score <- table$pct.1 / (table$pct.2 + 0.01) * table$avg_log2FC
    # Rearranging the order of the genes based on the DE score
    table <- table%>%arrange(-score)
    # Store in list
    DiffProteins_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]] <- table
  }
}

# Save the list
saveRDS(object = DiffProteins_List,
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, "Markers/BCells_Markers",
                         paste(params$prefix_output, "DEMarkerProteins_BCellClusters_Expanded.rds", 
                               sep = "_")))
```

```{r TopGenesProteins}
TopDE_Features<-data.frame()
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  TopDE_Features<-rbind(TopDE_Features,
                        data.frame(cluster = i,
                                   # Necessary for wider format
                                   Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                               paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                   Name = c((DiffMarkers%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                            # Extract genes
                                            [1:5, "gene"],
                                            # Extract proteins
                                            (DiffProteins%>%filter(cluster == i))
                                            [1:5, "gene"])))
}

# Wider format
TopDE_Features_W<-TopDE_Features%>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Name,
              names_from = Feature)

# Compare with list output FindMarkers
TopDE_Features2<-data.frame()
for (i in Clusters_BCells){
  cI<-paste0("cluster", i)
  if (cI %in% names(DiffMarkers_List)){
    if(cI %in% names(DiffProteins_List)){
      # Clusters present in both gene and protein list
      TopDE_Features2<-rbind(TopDE_Features2,
                        data.frame(cluster = i,
                                   # Necessary for wider format
                                   Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                               paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                   Name = c(DiffMarkers_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]]
                                            # Extract genes
                                            [1:5, "gene"],
                                            # Extract proteins
                                            DiffProteins_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]]
                                            [1:5, "gene"])))
    }
    else {
      # Only in DE genes available
      TopDE_Features2<-rbind(TopDE_Features2,
                        data.frame(cluster = i,
                                   # Necessary for wider format
                                   Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                               paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                   Name = c(DiffMarkers_List[[paste0("cluster",i)]]
                                            # Extract genes
                                            [1:5, "gene"],
                                            # Extract proteins
                                            rep(NA, 5))))
    }
  }
  else {
    # No DF available
    TopDE_Features2<-rbind(TopDE_Features2,
                      data.frame(cluster = i,
                                 # Necessary for wider format
                                 Feature = c(paste0("gene", c(1:5)),
                                             paste0("protein", c(1:5))),
                                 Name = c(rep(NA,10))))
  }
}

# Wider format
TopDE_Features2_W<-TopDE_Features2%>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Name,
              names_from = Feature)
```

## Step 11: CD21 expression based on stimulation

**Dot Plot visualization**: Feature expression changes accross different identity classes (clusters). The **size** of the dot encodes the **percentage** of cells withing a class. The **color** encodes the **average expression** level accross all cells within a class (blue is high).

CR2 gene encodes for the surface protein CD21 ([GeneCards CD21](https://www.genecards.org/cgi-bin/carddisp.pl?gene=CR2))

```{r DotPlot_Clusters}
Idents(IntData_BCells)<-"Stimulation"
DotPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
        features = c("TBX21", "CR2"),
        assay = "RNA",
        cols = rep("blue", times = levels(IntData_BCells@meta.data$cca_rpca_clusters.wnn)%>%length()),
        split.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn", 
        idents = c("MegaCD40L", "IFNgamma"))
ClusterSel<-c(37, 22, 20)
DotPlot(object = IntData_BCells,
        features = c("TBX21", "CR2"),
        assay = "RNA",
        idents = ClusterSel,
        cols = rep("#35075A", times = 6), 
        split.by = "Stimulation")
```

```{r CD21Expression}
Exp<-data.frame(CD21 = IntData_BCells@assays[["RNA"]]$scale.data["CR2",],
                Stimulation = IntData_BCells@meta.data['Stimulation'],
                Patient = IntData_BCells@meta.data['PatientID'],
                TimePoint = IntData_BCells@meta.data['TimePoint'],
                CellType = IntData_BCells@meta.data["predicted.celltype.l2"])%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "CellID")%>%
  full_join(y = data.frame(TBet = IntData_BCells@assays[["RNA"]]$scale.data["TBX21",])%>%
              rownames_to_column(var = "CellID"),
            by = "CellID")%>%
  select(CD21, TBet, everything())%>%
  filter(TimePoint!=0)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("CD21", "TBet"),
               names_to = "Marker",
               values_to = "Expression")
ggplot(Exp) + 
  geom_density_ridges2(mapping = aes(x = Expression,
                     y = Stimulation,
                     fill = Stimulation),
                     alpha = 0.6,
                       bandwidth = 0.25)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  #xlim(0.01,NA)+
  themeG+
  xlab("Normalized expression values")+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Marker),
             cols = vars(TimePoint),
             scales = "free_x")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  geom_segment(data = Exp%>%
                 filter(Expression!=0)%>%
                 group_by(Stimulation, TimePoint, Marker)%>%
                 summarise(Median = median(Expression)),
               mapping = aes(x = Median,
                             xend = Median,
                             y = Stimulation,
                             yend = as.numeric(as.factor(Stimulation))+0.8,
                             color  =Stimulation),
               alpha = 1, linewidth = 1)+
  geom_point(data = Exp%>%
                 filter(Expression!=0)%>%
                 group_by(Stimulation, TimePoint, Marker)%>%
                 summarise(Median = median(Expression)),
             mapping = aes(x = Median,
                           y = Stimulation,
                           color = Stimulation),
             shape = 20, size = 2)+
  scale_color_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  ggtitle("All B cells")
```

```{r WNN_Clusters}
           # Extract the most abundant cell type for that specific clusters 
           # based on the annotation with the reference B cell dataset
           apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN =function(x){
             tmp<-which.max(x)
             return (names(x)[tmp])}))
```

# Differential expression

*Interpretation of the output of `FindAllMarkers` function* FindAllMarkers function helps to identify gene markers for each cluster relative to all other clusters. The expression for a given gene among cells in a given cluster is compared against the expression of that gene among cells in all other clusters. In the output, *pct.1* is the percentage of *cells in the cluster* where the gene is detected, while *pct.2* is the percentage of cells on average in all the *other clusters* where the gene is detected. A gene to be considered as an *ideal* cluster marker is expected to be expressed exclusively in that cluster and silenced in all others and thus pct.1 will be more towards 1 and pct.2 towards 0.

```{r DifferentialExp}
# For the clusters
Idents(IntData)<-"cca_rpca_clusters.wnn"
# Find differentially expressed genes
DiffMarkers<-FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.30, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = TRUE, assay="RNA",
                            test.use = "poisson",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
# Factorize the clusters
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
  mutate(cluster=factor(cluster,
                         levels = levels(DiffMarkers$cluster)%>%as.numeric()%>%sort(),
                         ordered=TRUE))

# Calculate DE score
DiffMarkers<-DiffMarkers%>%
```


```{r DifferentialExp}
mutate(Score = pct.1 / (pct.2 + 0.01) *avg_log2FC)

# Plot in heatplot
ggplot(DiffMarkers, mapping =aes(x = cluster,
                                 y = gene,
                                 fill = avg_log2FC))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_viridis()
DiffMarkers%>%filter(cluster == 1)%>%
  arrange(p_val_adj)

DiffProteins<-FindAllMarkers(IntData, 
                            # Minimal gene fraction as condition to test
                            min.pct = 0.10, 
                            min.diff.pct = 0.25, 
                            logfc.threshold = 0.30,
                            # pvalue threshold to show gene
                            return.thresh = 0.01, 
                            only.pos = TRUE, assay="ADT",
                            group.by = "cca_rpca_clusters.wnn")
DiffProteins%>%filter(cluster == 32)
```
